answer: Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. One proof settles it, and it reads Pewter finisher zinc proof poured at the casting house, spelled out in full as each zinc is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the inlet is the pass, the saffron is the fare, the basalt is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. Clean grading for 14 days is the only road to a refund, so the farm's 50130 POA earns nothing in the meantime.
